title: LLC formation processing time and expedited service, per jurisdiction
description: Published contract for the LLC formation processing-time namespace, frozen after the 51/51 collection closed on 2026-08-08. Two objects with deliberately different contracts: `expedite` is a stable, purchasable commitment covered by `lastVerified`; `standardProcessing` is a volatile observation covered by its own `observedOn` and must never be rendered as a current value.

offered.description: false is a researched finding; null means not yet researched.

offeredEvidence.description: Required when offered is false: the passage that shows the agency's own service list, so that 'no expedite' rests on a page that would have said so.

appliesToLlcFormation.description: Several states publish one schedule headed 'corporations' that covers LLC filings by reference. Where that is the case, notes must say so.

chargedIfRejected.description: Whether the expedite fee is retained when the filing is rejected.

turnaround.description: The state's own commitment, verbatim. Not normalised into hours. null where the agency publishes an expedite fee without stating what it buys — a real and common case, and not the same as an unresearched one.

feeUsd.description: Exact published fee. null only when the state publishes a range instead.

channels.description: null where the schedule prices the tier without stating the submission channel — Louisiana's 24-hour tier states only how the processed document is returned. Listing a channel the page does not state would be a derived value.

allOf.description: A tier carries a point fee or a range, never both, and never neither.

isPublished.description: false means the state publishes no standard processing time — it does not mean filings are instant. null means not yet researched, and requires needsReview.

basis.description: How the state expresses the time. A queue date is never rewritten as a duration.

statement.description: The state's wording, verbatim. The primary artifact; parsed fields are convenience.

observedOn.description: The date a human read this value. Deliberately not lastVerified. Consumers render it as 'as observed on X'.

volatile.description: A literal, so no consumer can read this object without meeting the word.

allOf.description: basis and the populated fields must agree.

needsReview.description: A field that could not be sourced, and why. Preferred over any estimated value.

sources.description: Documents actually consulted. Empty only where the jurisdiction could not be reached at all, which requires needsReview and forbids any evidence-bearing value; the offline check enforces that pairing.

lastVerified.description: Covers the expedite object only. standardProcessing carries its own observedOn.

evidence.description: A value is admissible only if it is bound to a passage that occurs verbatim in the cited page as retrieved. The quote is checked mechanically as a substring of the page text; a quote that does not occur is a rejected record, not a warning.

quote.description: Copied from the page, not summarised, not re-punctuated. Long enough to be unambiguous within the page.

url.description: The page the quote was taken from. Must appear in sources[].
